primitives.assumptions: All percentage values conform to 0–100 scale and match nflverse reference data.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs if any column deviates from expected 0–100 range or mismatches source data.

layer2.telemetry: Column-wise verification results and deviation flags.

primitives.name: Board State Node Posture
primitives.verbatim_quote: Board state → node posture (published glow / gate-held dim / scoring pulse) with inspector chips.
primitives.assumptions: Node states transition deterministically based on board condition and inspector feedback.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Posture changes fail if board state does not reflect current node conditions.

layer2.telemetry: Inspector chip outputs and node state transitions.
